Multi-bore circular milled component
Angled access and continuous contours

Angled features may be reached by indexed positioning; continuous contours may need a simultaneous tool path. We review the model before choosing the machining route.

Geometry & process
For continuous curves, deep cavities and features requiring angled tool access. Impellers, curved components and multi-sided housings use angled tool access and contour machining.
Size & workholding
Review the clamping areas, tool reach and clearance across the required orientations. Identify protected surfaces and features that must share a setup; use the size-review checklist below to provide the model and dimensions.
Material & finish
Services cover aluminum, titanium, Inconel and hardened stainless. Specify the grade, material condition and finish requirements, including surfaces where tool marks matter.
Review your part size & setup

Include finished length, width, height and weight, stock dimensions and weight, protected surfaces, clamping areas and clearances. Send the model, drawing, material and quantity; machine travel, load and maximum part envelope are not published here.

Five-axis machining for multi-face components

Machining holes, side openings and contoured faces on a component held in a rotary setup.

Two milling setups for one part

Two milling setups provide access to different faces of the same part.

Drawing & acceptance
Drawing requirements

Identify the functional surfaces and the relationships between angled holes, bores and mounting faces. Specify which model revision defines the contour.

Mark restricted tool access, thin blades, deep cavities and surfaces where tool marks matter. Discuss acceptable changes before fixing the route.

Inspection and acceptance

Define profile and position requirements with usable datums. Agree the features to compare with the model or measure.

For rotating or fluid-handling parts, identify any separate balance, leak or functional test requirement; geometry alone does not demonstrate performance.

Agree the measurement method and required records before production.

Quality & inspection
Equipment and order records
Prepare your 5-axis machining enquiry

Provide the native or neutral 3D model, a drawing of critical features, material condition and finish requirements.

Include assembly clearances and any validation criteria to help assess feasibility and the reports and work to include in the quotation.

Prepare RFQ email

Add your requirements to the email draft, then attach drawings in your email app before sending.
